summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction entry under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Nothing was run or installed, so tests and black are unverified; line lengths were checked with awk (none over 120) and wrapping by reading. Nothing was committed. Beyond the spec: non-object top-level JSON and non-list key values raise ValueError, and items are copied rather than mutated.
